_comment: Canonical Sunless by Jimmy Coco tanning routine. DRAFT v0.1.0. Every AI-generated hero/video must declare which step(s) it depicts. A product may not be shown acting outside the routine_positions declared in its product-truth file. 'wardrobe' gives the step-appropriate styling; see _shared/creative-rules.md for full wardrobe rules.

styling.modesty: modest & premium (spa-luxury, editorial; never lingerie-styled or sexualised; TikTok/IG-safe)

apply_wardrobe_varies_by_setting.bathroom_bedroom: towel wrapped and tucked just under the armpits (strapless)

routine.label: Prep
routine.description: Exfoliate and ready clean, dry skin before tanning.
routine.wardrobe: A robe slipped off the limb being buffed, or a towel. Most-covered step; skin dry, no product yet.

routine.label: Apply
routine.description: Apply self-tan evenly to the skin.
routine.wardrobe: Minimal and stain-safe, straps moved clear (no strap tan-lines, nothing catches product). Towel under the arms indoors, or dark swimwear for coastal. Never a t-shirt or good clothes over an area being tanned. No white/pale fabric near wet product.

routine.label: Develop
routine.description: Allow the tan to develop. Nothing is applied in this step.
routine.wardrobe: Loose, DARK, breathable (black oversized tee + shorts, or a robe) so the developing tan doesn't rub off or transfer. Never tight or light-coloured.

routine.label: Glow / Maintain
routine.description: Reveal and maintain the developed tan; weekly upkeep and top-ups.
routine.wardrobe: Styled to show the glow: white/cream/neutral or a going-out look; jewellery back on; hair down; reveal outfit pristine.
